comparison.objective: Select the correct tool from a cluttered pile and hand it over handle first; candidate tunes and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Semantic tool selection, clutter extraction, reorientation, and handover versus tool-to-fastener alignment, counterholding, fine collar rotation, locking, and guarded cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Correct mallet handed over in the required orientation while other tools remain undisturbed; exact pose/contact thresholds are missing. Candidate requires two safe stops and post-lock drift control.
comparison.reason: Cluttered retrieval and handover exercise selection and transfer, not damping commissioning or mechanical setting retention.
